Definition: Avvim (as inhabited by Avvites), a place in Palestine (with the article prefix)
BiblicalUsage: Avvim was the place where the Avvites lived before the Caphtorim destroyed them, on the coast toward Gaza, and Deuteronomy remembers it in the story of the peoples displaced before Israel. Joshua lists Avvim among the cities of Benjamin's inheritance — a small place, named only twice.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even two mentions are enough: God remembers small towns and displaced peoples, and his record of the land is exact.
